layout.demoNotice: Demo accounts exist only in this browser: there is no server, and no real email or SMS is sent. Please do not reuse a real password.

fields.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
fields.codeHint: Enter the 6 digits from the message.
fields.usernameHint: 3 to 24 characters: letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens.
fields.emailHint: We will send a 6-digit code to confirm it.

validation.usernameChars: Use only letters, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens.
validation.passwordWeak: Choose a stronger password. See the checklist below.

rules.title: Your password needs
rules.notPersonal: No part of your username or email

google.loadError: The Google button could not be loaded. Check your connection or ad blocker, then try again.
google.privacy: The Google button is loaded from accounts.google.com, so Google can see that you opened this page.
google.demoDialogBody: Google sign-in is not set up in this build, so this is only a simulation. No Google account is used and nothing is sent to Google.
google.setupIntro: To sign in with a real Google account you need your own OAuth client ID. Creating one takes a few minutes and needs a Google account.
google.step1: In the Google Cloud console open APIs & Services, then Credentials, and create an OAuth client ID of type “Web application”.
google.step2: Under “Authorized JavaScript origins” add {{origin}}. When testing on localhost, also add http://localhost.
google.step3: Paste the client ID below. It is a public identifier, not a secret. Never paste a client secret.
google.saved: Google client ID saved. The real Google button is now active.
google.fromBuild: This site was built with a Google client ID.
google.errorFormat: That is not a Google client ID. A client ID ends with .apps.googleusercontent.com.
google.errorSecret: That looks like a client secret. Never paste secrets here. Use the client ID instead.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Make a demo account to try signing in. It is stored only in this browser.
register.doneBody: Welcome, {{name}}. You are now signed in.

otp.sentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Open the Demo inbox to read it.
otp.sentGeneric: If an account matches, a 6-digit code was sent to its email address. Open the Demo inbox to read it.
otp.resendIn_one: You can ask for a new code in {{count}} second.
otp.resendIn_other: You can ask for a new code in {{count}} seconds.
otp.resent: A new code was sent. Check the Demo inbox.

errors.invalidCredentials: Incorrect username, email address or password.
errors.locked_one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.locked_other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.rateLimited_one: Too many requests. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.rateLimited_other: Too many requests. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.otpExpired: This code has expired. Send a new code.
errors.otpLocked: Too many wrong codes. Send a new code to try again.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too weak. See the checklist.
errors.cryptoUnavailable: Secure password hashing is not available on this address. Open the site over https:// or on localhost.
errors.googleToken: Google's reply could not be read. Please try again.
errors.googleAudience: Google's reply was meant for a different app. Check the client ID.
errors.googleExpired: The Google sign-in has expired. Please try again.
errors.googleUnverified: Your Google email address is not verified, so it cannot be used here.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.otpInvalid: That code is not correct. Attempts remaining: {{count}}.

forgotUsername.title: Forgot your username?
forgotUsername.subtitle: Enter your email address. We will send a code to confirm it is yours.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your username or email address. We will send a code so you can choose a new password.
forgotPassword.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.

inbox.title: Demo inbox
inbox.description: This build has no mail server or SMS gateway, so the messages ChainBeat “sends” appear here instead. Nothing leaves your browser.
inbox.empty: No messages yet. When you ask for a code, the message appears here.
inbox.arrived: New message in the Demo inbox.
inbox.neverShare: Never share this code. ChainBeat will never ask for your code, a seed phrase or a private key.
inbox.registerBody: Use this code to confirm your email address and finish creating your account.
inbox.resetBody: Use this code to choose a new password. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message.
inbox.recoverBody: Use this code to confirm it is you and see your username. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message.
inbox.noAccountBody: We received a request for this address, but no ChainBeat account uses it. If it was you, you can create an account. If not, you can ignore this message.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: The demo account you are signed in with.
account.storage: This account exists only in this browser's local storage. It is not on any server.
account.deleteBody: This removes the account from this browser. It cannot be undone.

toast.passwordReset: Password updated. You can sign in now.
